name: mirflickr_benchmark_1k
description: A small-scale benchmark built from the MIRFLICKR image collection for evaluating image annotation and image retrieval methods. It provides images with multi-label annotations commonly used to test multi-label classification, tag prediction, and retrieval algorithms. Often used as a baseline dataset for evaluating feature representations and multi-label learning approaches.
reputation: A long-standing, widely cited small-scale benchmark in image annotation and retrieval literature, commonly used for baseline comparisons though less prominent than larger modern datasets.
